relationships.history: Roommate, shift lead, big sister she never had. She'd follow Sol into traffic, singing.
Sienna reposted one of her sleeve drawings and Imani hasn't recovered.
The resident who falls asleep on the counter. She draws him every morning and he never notices.

memories.info: Sienna Brooks reposted a coffee-sleeve sketch: 1,400 likes overnight.

profile.tagline: Draws the whole town on coffee sleeves, one regular at a time.

appearance.face: round face, a gap in her front teeth, a tiny nose stud
appearance.hair: box braids in a high bun with a yellow scarf
appearance.style: a mustard cardigan over a striped tee, a canvas barista apron covered in pen marks, wide-leg jeans, yellow trainers

outfits.everyday: an oversized lilac hoodie, baggy light-wash jeans, yellow trainers, the yellow scarf in her braids, mismatched earrings
outfits.work: a mustard cardigan over a striped tee, a canvas barista apron covered in pen marks, wide-leg jeans, yellow trainers, the yellow scarf in her braids
outfits.evening: a cobalt-blue satin slip dress over a white baby tee, chunky white platform trainers, a cobalt scarf in her braids, mismatched gold earrings

appearance.jewelry: mismatched earrings, a nose stud, pens behind both ears
appearance.silhouette: a high bun of braids with a yellow scarf, an apron covered in ink
key_features: Box braids in a high bun with a yellow scarf

profile.family_background: Chapeltown, Leeds. Her mum is a bus driver, her dad a carpenter from Kingston. She moved to America for art school, ran out of money, and kept going west.
profile.education: One year of illustration at Leeds Arts University
goals: A show of the coffee-sleeve drawings
Get Sienna to notice her again
ambitions: Illustrate a book with her name on the spine

secrets.truth: She sends photos from behind the counter to @livera.unfiltered's DMs. She has no idea who runs it.

social_media.bio: Barista. I drew you. You're welcome.

life_history: Drew her whole school, badly, on the back of exam papers.
Dropped out of art school when the money did.
Barista at Heritage Coffee; draws everyone on the sleeves.
